# reverse_check_allowlist.txt — endpoint ids the OpenAPI document does not
# describe yet.
#
# TestSpecRouterConformance/manifest_reverse_check reads
# apps/elitea-web/src/shared/api/endpoints.manifest.json and requires every
# endpoint the new UI calls to be covered by api/openapi/v2.yaml. The 94 ids
# below are the Wave-2 hand-written slices (source:"handwritten",
# operationId:null in the manifest). Spec §5.3 expects them to arrive in the
# document one by one.
#
# RULES
# - The list may only shrink. Describe the endpoint in v2.yaml, then delete
#   its line here. The test fails on a line the spec now covers.
# - Do not add a line. A new endpoint that the spec does not describe must
#   fail the gate. maxAllowlistEntries in conformance_test.go pins the size.
#
# One id per line. `#` starts a comment.
